title: Run nerv-planner once and record it in the Gauntlet ledger
goal: The first real-model result of every nerv-planner case is in evals/gauntlet/ledger.json, with what failed and why
acceptance: After F-120-T13's ok: nerv-planner/* runs once (--allow-models --execute, profile gemma4-12b.json, in a development worktree, never ~/.nerv-app, not while the owner uses the local model) and is recorded in evals/gauntlet/ledger.json
Failed cases are read with --capture-failures and each is recorded as a model answer, a case problem (fixed in a new pack version) or a NERV defect (a B- record)

Progress 2026-11-27 (owner-approved night): 1.1.0 ran 01:10 on gemma4:26b and gemma4:12b (19 cases not run after a 30 s timeout, F-120-T18); 1.2.0 ran 01:49 on both, every case ran, and both reports are in the ledger (26b 17/36, 12b 18/36). 22 of 37 failed replies matched by hash: reminders.list instead of reminders.add (4 cases, both models) or tools.read (routing), grover.grover_overview before declining (26b: tent light, switched-off print, promotion; 12b: table booking), docs.list or lists.show on trip-place-en, ask or agency.status on pilot-promote (12b). Remaining: a --capture-failures run of the unmatched cases (memory-fact, print-feet, some decline cases), which needs the owner

Owner 2026-11-27 (about 10:00) in chat: "ok" to one --capture-failures run. Commands, from a development worktree at origin/main with node_modules installed and OUT a new private directory outside any checkout (failure capture needs a new absolute directory there): for gemma4:12b (node_modules/@voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol/examples/profiles/gemma4-12b.json) and then gemma4:26b (evals/gauntlet/profiles/gemma4-26b.json): node tools/gauntlet.mjs model-run --pack=nerv-planner --profile=<profile> --allow-models --execute --fresh --capture-failures=$OUT/f120-t14-capture-<model> --out=$OUT/f120-t14-planner-<model>.json, then node tools/gauntlet.mjs inspect-failures --directory=$OUT/f120-t14-capture-<model> --report=$OUT/f120-t14-planner-<model>.json. At most 36 cases x 120 s each (suite 18 min per model). No ledger write: model-run does not record, and the captured replies stay private evidence; queued after the 2026-11-27 night's other stages
privacy: Neutral invented data only; captured replies stay private evidence, never committed.
escalation: A second run or a different model needs the owner again

effort.basis: Runs and ledger done 2026-11-27; 0.25 h left to read the unmatched failures from one --capture-failures run. Not a measurement.
